title: Can We Get the Lead Out? Updates to the Lead and Copper Rule for Public Drinking Water
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy
abstract: Despite the well-documented dangers of lead exposure, millions of homes still rely on lead service lines (LSLs), contributing to elevated lead levels in drinking water. This article discusses the Lead and Copper Rule Improvements (LCRI), which aim to accelerate the removal of LSLs and to strengthen public health protections. The article highlights the LCRI’s key provisions, including mandatory LSL replacement throughout the country within 10 years, stricter lead action levels, improved tap sampling methods, required testing in schools, and expanded public communication and transparency. Although the LCRI represents significant progress, challenges related to funding, legal barriers, and equitable implementation remain. Addressing these obstacles is crucial for achieving the goal of eliminating lead exposure through drinking water and protecting vulnerable populations, especially children.
abstract_zh: 尽管铅暴露的危害已有充分记录，但仍有数百万户家庭依赖铅质入户管线（LSLs），这导致饮用水中铅含量升高。本文讨论了《铅和铜规则改进》（LCRI），该规则旨在加快铅质入户管线的移除，并加强公共健康保护。本文重点介绍了LCRI的主要条款，包括要求全国在10年内强制更换铅质入户管线、制定更严格的铅行动限值、改进龙头取样方法、要求学校进行检测，以及扩大公众沟通与信息透明度。尽管LCRI取得了显著进展，但与资金、法律障碍以及公平实施相关的挑战依然存在。克服这些障碍，对于实现通过饮用水消除铅暴露、保护弱势群体（尤其是儿童）的目标至关重要。

title: Expanding Health Insurance to Parents: Effect on Children's Care Use and Health
Targeting Distributional Impacts in the Presence of Behavioral Responses: Lessons from Maritime Emission Regulation
venue: Environmental and Energy Policy and the Economy
abstract: Targeting distributional impacts is gaining importance in the design of environmental policy. To achieve this, policy makers are adopting advances in air transport models to predict the benefits of air emissions regulation. These models offer policy makers accuracy in the spatial distribution of ambient air quality improvements for a given emissions reduction, but do not take into account behavioral responses to environmental policies. We consider how the failure to account for behavioral responses when making policy predictions may have important implications for the ultimate distributional impact of such policies. We compare the distributional impacts of maritime emission regulation predicted from the policy maker's air transport model to the realized distributional impacts. We then decompose the prediction error from two components: model error, whereby the predictions of air transport models fail to account for behavioral responses of polluting firms, and sorting error, whereby the targeted population migrates.
abstract_zh: 在环境政策设计中，针对分配性影响的重要性日益凸显。为此，政策制定者正在采用空气传输模型的最新进展，以预测空气排放管制的效益。这些模型能够为既定的减排量提供关于环境空气质量改善空间分布的精确预测，但并未考虑污染企业和环境政策之间的行为反应。我们考察了在进行政策预测时未能考虑行为反应，可能会对此类政策最终的分配影响产生何种重要后果。我们将政策制定者的空气传输模型所预测的海运排放管制分配影响，与实际实现的分配影响进行了比较。随后，我们将预测误差分解为两个组成部分：模型误差，即空气传输模型的预测未能考虑污染企业的行为反应；以及分选误差，即目标人群发生迁移。

title: A Watershed Moment: The Clean Water Act and Birth Weight
abstract: The Clean Water Act (CWA) significantly improved surface water quality, but at a cost exceeding the estimated benefits. We quantify the effect of the CWA on a direct measure of health. Using a difference-in-differences framework, we compare birth weight upstream and downstream from wastewater treatment facilities before and after CWA grant receipt. Pollution only decreased downstream from facilities required to upgrade their treatment technology, and we leverage this additional variation with a triple difference. CWA grants increased average birth weight by 8 grams.
abstract_zh: 《清洁水法》（CWA）显著改善了地表水质量，但其成本超过了估计收益。我们量化了《清洁水法》对一项直接健康指标的影响。利用双重差分框架，我们比较了在获得《清洁水法》补助前后，污水处理设施上游和下游的出生体重。污染仅在被要求升级处理技术的设施下游有所下降，我们利用这一额外变异，采用三重差分进行分析。《清洁水法》补助使平均出生体重增加了8克。

title: Testing Above the Limit: Drinking Water Contamination and Test Scores
abstract: This paper provides estimates of the contemporaneous effect of drinking water quality violations on students’ academic achievement. Using student-level test score data with residential addresses, geographic information on water systems, and drinking water violations from North Carolina, I estimate the within-student impacts of poor water quality on student test scores. Exposure to a bacteria violation during the school year decreases math scores by about 0.038 standard deviations when the public is uninformed. Results suggest that poor water quality may impact retention or comprehension of material throughout the school year.
abstract_zh: 本文估计饮用水水质违规行为对学生学业成绩的同期影响。利用包含住址信息的学生层面考试成绩数据、供水系统地理信息以及北卡罗来纳州的饮用水违规记录，我估计了水质恶化对学生考试成绩的个体内影响。当公众不知情时，学年内遭遇细菌超标违规会使数学成绩下降约0.038个标准差。研究结果表明，水质不佳可能会影响学生在整个学年中对课程内容的记忆或理解。

title: Uncharted Waters: Effects of Maritime Emission Regulation
abstract: Maritime shipping emits as much fine particulate matter as half of global road traffic. We are the first to measure the consequences of US maritime emissions standards on air quality, human health, racial exposure disparities, and behavior. The introduction of US maritime emissions control areas significantly decreased fine particulate matter, low birth weight, and infant mortality. Yet, only about half of the forecasted fine particulate matter abatement was achieved by the policy. We show evidence consistent with behavioral responses among ship operators, other polluters, and individuals that muted the policy’s impact, but were not incorporated in ex-ante models.
abstract_zh: 海运排放的细颗粒物相当于全球公路交通排放量的一半。我们首次衡量了美国海运排放标准对空气质量、人类健康、种族暴露差异以及行为的影响。美国海上排放控制区的设立，显著降低了细颗粒物浓度、低出生体重率和婴儿死亡率。然而，该政策实际实现的细颗粒物减排量，仅约为事前预测减排量的一半。我们的证据表明，船舶运营商、其他污染者以及个人的行为反应削弱了该政策的影响，而这些反应并未被纳入事前模型之中。

title: Unregulated Contaminants in Drinking Water: Evidence from PFAS and Housing Prices
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: Our understanding of individuals' response to information about unregulated contaminants is limited. We leverage the highly publicized social discovery of unregulated PFAS (per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances) contamination in public drinking water to study the impact of information about unregulated contaminants on housing prices. Using residential property transaction data, we employ a difference-in-differences research design and show that high profile media coverage about PFAS contamination significantly decreased property values of affected homes. We also find suggestive evidence of residential sorting that may have worsened environmental inequality.
abstract_zh: 我们对个人如何应对未受监管污染物相关信息的理解仍很有限。我们利用公共饮用水中未受监管的全氟和多氟烷基物质（PFAS）污染被社会广泛披露这一事件，研究未受监管污染物相关信息对房价的影响。利用住宅房产交易数据，我们采用双重差分研究设计，结果表明，关于PFAS污染的高关注度媒体报道显著降低了受影响住宅的房产价值。我们还发现了居住分化的初步证据，这种分化可能加剧了环境不平等。

title: Bad Lighting: Effects of Youth Indoor Tanning Prohibitions
State SUNucate Laws, the Popularity of Google Searches for Terms Related to Sun Protection, and Youth Sunscreen Use
Burying the Lead: Effects of Public Lead Service Line Replacements on Blood Lead Levels and Property Values
Testing the Water: Drinking Water Quality, Public Notification, and Child Outcomes
venue: The Review of Economics and Statistics
abstract: Health-based drinking water violations affect about one in twelve Americans annually, yet the benefits of drinking water regulation are not well understood. I exploit plausibly exogenous variation in water quality violation timing to estimate the impacts on avoidance behavior and child outcomes. Using purchases of bottled water and common stomach remedies, emergency room visits for gastrointestinal illness, and school absences, I provide a comprehensive calculation of costs associated with poor drinking water quality. Individuals avoid the negative health impacts of coliform bacteria violations only when informed immediately. Timely public notification is a cost-effective way to induce avoidance behavior and protect health.
abstract_zh: 以健康为基础的饮用水违规行为每年影响约十二分之一的美国人，然而饮用水监管的收益尚未得到充分理解。我利用水质违规发生时间中合理外生的变异，估计其对规避行为及儿童结局的影响。通过考察瓶装水及常用胃药的购买情况、因胃肠道疾病而到急诊室就诊的次数以及学生缺课情况，我全面计算了饮用水质量不佳所带来的相关成本。只有在立即获知信息的情况下，个人才能避免大肠菌群违规行为所带来的负面健康影响。及时的公众告知是一种诱导规避行为、保护健康的成本有效手段。

title: The Effect of Free School Meals on Household Food Purchases: Evidence from the Community Eligibility Provision
Going Beneath the Surface: Petroleum Pollution, Regulation, and Health
abstract: This paper quantifies the health impacts of petroleum leaks from underground storage tanks, the effectiveness of tank regulation, and the role of information as a policy tool in the same setting. Exposure to a leaking underground storage tank during gestation increases both the probability of low birthweight and preterm birth by 7–8 percent. Compliance with regulations requiring the adoption of preventative technologies mitigated the entire effect of leak exposure on low birthweight, and information increased avoidance and moving among highly educated mothers. Back-of-the-envelope calculations suggest the health benefits of preventative regulations exceed the upgrade cost to facilities. (JEL I12, K32, L71, L78, Q35, Q51, Q53)
abstract_zh: 本文量化了地下储油罐石油泄漏对健康的影响、储罐监管的有效性，以及在同一背景下信息作为政策工具的作用。孕期接触泄漏的地下储油罐，会使低出生体重和早产的概率分别增加7%至8%。遵守要求采用预防性技术的监管规定，减轻了泄漏暴露对低出生体重的全部影响；此外，信息提高了受过高等教育母亲的规避行为和搬迁行为。粗略估算表明，预防性监管所带来的健康收益超过了设施的升级成本。（JEL分类：I12, K32, L71, L78, Q35, Q51, Q53）

title: Pollution at Schools and Children's Aerobic Capacity
abstract: Poor respiratory health is a major cause of mortality and morbidity worldwide, and children are especially vulnerable. Existing research in economics has documented the effect of pollution on severe health outcomes, such as hospitalizations for asthma and infant death. However, evidence on the effect of air pollution on less extreme measures of respiratory health is limited, because these effects are difficult to measure. Using a more sensitive measure, aerobic capacity (), I study the impact of air pollution on respiratory performance of children. I combine school‐grade level data from the California Physical Fitness Test from 2009 to 2017 with local air pollution and weather data to estimate the impact on student aerobic capacity of fluctuations in air pollution levels on testing days. Ozone affects child aerobic capacity at levels even below the Environmental Protection Agency thresholds.
abstract_zh: 呼吸系统健康不良是全球死亡和发病的主要原因，而儿童尤其脆弱。经济学领域的现有研究已经记录了污染对严重健康结局的影响，例如哮喘住院和婴儿死亡。然而，关于空气污染对较轻微的呼吸健康指标影响的证据有限，因为这些影响难以测量。我使用一种更为敏感的指标——有氧能力（）——研究空气污染对儿童呼吸功能的影响。我将2009年至2017年加州体能测试（California Physical Fitness Test）的年级层面学校数据，与当地空气污染和天气数据相结合，估计测试日空气污染水平的波动对学生有氧能力的影响。臭氧对儿童有氧能力的影响，即使在低于美国环境保护署（EPA）阈值的水平下也存在。

title: The Role of Parallel Trends in Event Study Settings: An Application to Environmental Economics
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: Difference-in-differences (DID) research designs usually rely on variation of treatment timing such that, after making an appropriate parallel trends assumption, one can identify, estimate, and make inference about causal effects. In practice, however, different DID procedures rely on different parallel trends assumptions (PTAs), and recover different causal parameters. In this paper, we focus on staggered DID (also referred as event studies) and discuss the role played by the PTA in terms of identification and estimation of causal parameters. We document a “robustness” versus “efficiency” trade-off in terms of the strength of the underlying PTA and argue that practitioners should be explicit about these trade-offs whenever using DID procedures. We propose new DID estimators that reflect these trade-offs and derive their large sample properties. We illustrate the practical relevance of these results by assessing whether the transition from federal to state management of the Clean Water Act affects compliance rates.
abstract_zh: 双重差分（DID）研究设计通常依赖于处理时点的变异，因而在作出适当的平行趋势假设之后，研究者可以识别、估计和推断因果效应。然而在实践中，不同的DID方法依赖于不同的平行趋势假设（PTAs），并恢复出不同的因果参数。本文关注交错型DID（亦称事件研究），讨论平行趋势假设在因果参数的识别与估计中所起的作用。我们揭示了平行趋势假设强度在“稳健性”与“效率”之间的权衡，并主张研究者在使用DID方法时，应明确这些权衡。我们提出了体现这些权衡的新DID估计量，并推导了其大样本性质。我们通过评估从联邦层面向州层面管理《清洁水法》的转变是否影响合规率，来说明这些结果的实际意义。

title: On the Road to Recovery: Gasoline Content Regulations and Child Health
